Murderer |TV actor =[[Tony Robinette]] }} '''Shopkeep Simon''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] and alleged owner of [[Sonny's Sundries]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sometime prior to [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]]'s arrival to [[New Vegas]], Simon, self-admittedly naked at the time, entered the [[Sonny's Sundries]] general store in Freeside to rob it. Through unknown means, he ended up murdering the store's namesake proprietor, [[Sonny]]. Afterward, Simon stripped the corpse and began wearing his clothes (despite them being comically undersized for him) to pass himself off as the owner of Sonny's Sundries. He also shoddily dismembered Sonny's body and left the remains in a trash can in the back of the store. He then made significant increases on the prices of the store's goods, such as raising the cost of [[Addictol (TV series)|Addictol]] from 125 to 1,000 caps. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Wrangler]]=== Shortly after escaping the [[Deathclaw (TV series)|deathclaws]] infesting the [[New Vegas Strip]], Lucy is given an allowance of caps by [[the Ghoul]] to go to Sonny's and get some Addictol for her [[Buffout addiction]]. However, she is dismayed to find the hiked-price of 1,000 caps. While walking away, she spots the open backdoor to the store and is compelled by her need for the cure to enter. Inside, she watches the shopkeep walk up to the second floor and steals an Addictol sample as well as a [[Power fist (TV series)|power fist]]. As she tries to leave, she is startled when she finds the chopped-up Sonny, causing Simon to notice her presence. Lucy initially tries to talk her way out of the situation until noticing the stretched-out clothes he's wearing and a portrait of Sonny looking nothing like the man in front of her, causing her to deduce who he really is. Simon tries to tell her Sonny just "left town" but gives up the ruse quickly once she points out the body. He tries to pick up a gun from a nearby display despite Lucy's warning, leading to her shooting him with her [[Lucy's pistol|pistol]] in self-defense. This ends up being a lethal shot, as Lucy finds him dead on the floor when she approaches. ==Appearances== Shopkeep Simon appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|13=205}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Freeside characters]] [[ru:Саймон (телесериал)]]
